scripts.api:dev: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn helm.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.api:lint: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check .
scripts.api:format: cd apps/api && uv run ruff format .
scripts.api:typecheck: cd apps/api && uv run mypy helm
scripts.migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.migrate:new: cd apps/api && uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m
